name: An Informal Summoning
source:
Someone is out to kill you, luckily, you were able to summon some horror for help. Talk to them and convince them that your request is worth their energy.

[From [url=https://fascinatingly-frightened.itch.io/an-informal-summoning]Itch.io[/url]]
